name: 91030 · S Pasadena, CA
findings: ZIP 91030 (S Pasadena) has 173 nonprofit organizations. 54 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 45 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 91030 (S Pasadena) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 91030 (S Pasadena) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 45 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.
